scope: Native Manager inspection of current canonical STEP renders, separate from independent blind review
observations: Overview preserves Sun outline, two open cups, two contrasting-pip dice and opposing flowing counter groups.
Neutral board top has twenty-four radial flat surfaces and four wider boundary gaps; each gap carries a short rounded marker with no endpoint dots.
Lane close-up shows broad checker bases on flat lane tops, and the capsule marker separated from counter footprints inside the gap.
Center close-up shows an open disk only slightly above lanes with three counters resting flat; no tall obstruction.

Capacity view shows five aligned columns on one lane. Their coincident layer seams are not visually distinct; actual fifteen-piece count and full layer contact are established separately by current geometry audit.
Opposite die views show all1–6 pip patterns in dark recesses; counter detail retains the single-tail and short late-fork contours.
